verdict.rationale: Phaser's agentic features are interactive and on-demand. The Game Agent MCP server lets a coding agent call tools when the user describes a change in plain language, and the hosted agent prompts the user for a game idea. Nothing in the evidence shows automations that can be set up to run on their own in the background, on a schedule, or from triggers. The MCP server is an adjacent capability and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
